question: Among the dated events recorded in the timeline, list the Missouri state legislative seats he was elected to and the Confederate general ranks he was commissioned or appointed to, in chronological order.
why_needs_multiple: Đáp án gồm hai chức vụ lập pháp bang và hai cấp bậc tướng Liên minh miền Nam, xen kẽ theo thời gian, nên cần gom nhiều mốc.
criterion: being elected to a Missouri state legislative seat (house or senate) or being commissioned or appointed to a Confederate general rank

gold_events.text: Elected to the Missouri state legislature.
Became Missouri state senator, serving until the Civil War.
Commissioned brigadier general of the Confederacy.
Appointed major general by Kirby Smith; never confirmed by Davis.

why_needs_multiple: Câu hỏi cần hai mốc cụ thể là lúc nộp đơn kiện và lúc tuyên án bồi thường để tính khoảng cách giữa chúng.
